schema_note: ADR 0010 units: XS 0.5, S 1, M 2, L 4. 'implemented' = built, reviewed in 3 fresh-context rounds and verified locally with command evidence. 'dod_done' = story-level DoD fully met (incl. merged to main with every CI gate green). No story is dod_done yet because CI has never run on GitHub and every test-change request is still pending QA approval (R3-02, QA-R3-02). Status values: done | partial | not_started.
